name: calm
note: The default for text-led films: soft natural touches, one tuned voice for bells and text, gentle air for moves, a single struck note for the lockup. Clicks, ticks, the pop, the snap, the space bar and the short whoosh are CC0 recordings fitted as code, where they measure closer to their role than the forge member (earshot match against the role's description and against synth-blip descriptions, earshot realness); the other touches are forge taps, the tuned voice is the launch film's measured kalimba. Every take passes the model-free audit (earshot kit check). Riser, swell, suck and drop are off: a reveal resolves on one element.

whoosh.transition.note: v1.1, one sound per event type (src/bits/v1/_shared/sfx.ts): every slide change; takes = earshot seeds of the same swish

whoosh.camera.note: v1.1: every camera move (pan, zoom, pull-back)

whoosh.panel.note: v1.1: a panel or sidebar sliding in, a device morph

land.card.note: v1.1: a window or card landing

land.object.note: v1.1: a small object landing (pill on the tray, dispenser parts, floors)

pop.item.note: v1.1: an item appearing (post-it, signal, graph node, vote, slot); Tom disliked ui_pop/soft here

pop.chat.note: v1.1: a chat bubble or question card arriving (ia-workflow)

snap.line.note: v1.1: a headline, quote, name or role landing: the soft shutter click (Tom: the lip pop sounded like a clap; this is the sound the calculator's photo finish used to play)

pop.pill.note: v1.1: a pill leaving the drum

key.calc.note: v1.1: a calculator rubber button (typing, save, select)

click.tap.note: v1.1: every finger tap on a phone or tablet

tick.scan.note: v1.1: a scan or check (QR scan, copilot name, CI check, row done, text selection)

tick.status.note: v1.1: a counter or status starting (arep counter, system row start, sncf mark)

snap.latch.note: v1.1: something snapping into place (kanban drop, fix applied)

bell.success.note: v1.1: a success (calculator result, CI pass, lint done, finish line)

tick.note: domino pieces knocking, a CC0 recording fitted as code (0.14 s): matches 'a soft quiet UI tick' at z +1.02, p 0.67 over synth-blip descriptions (tap/glass: -0.08, p 0.01), realness 0.83 (0.45); level +3 dB for its lower loudness at the same peak

tick.crisp.note: the same glass touch, tighter (98 ms, 225 Hz body + glass partial): crisp without a synthetic tink

tock.note: a knuckle knock: the low partner of the glass tick

hit.note: the lockup as one struck bell on the film's tonic (edits.pitch, set by kit.py tune: G4 in G major), single attack, no build, 1.9 s natural decay: a soft tonal resolve instead of a boom

land.note: a round low thump (75 Hz body, 0.18 s): an element settling, felt more than heard

land.light.note: a soft fingertip thump for small elements landing

pop.note: a soft mouth plop, a CC0 recording fitted as code (0.28 s), no pitch glide: matches 'a soft natural pop' at z +2.98, p 1.00 over synth-blip descriptions (pro_pop_in/airy: +1.88, 0.98), realness 0.97 (0.65)

whoosh.short.note: a short whoosh, a CC0 recording fitted as code (0.48 s, one smooth pass): matches 'a short fast whoosh swish through the air' at z +5.32 (swipe/velvet, which reads as 'a heavy thud': +2.01), realness 0.99 (0.97)

whoosh.long.note: a gentle air swell (1.36 s, peak at 0.44 s) for scene moves: air, not a sub-led designed whoosh

key.note: a thocky mechanical key, a new take per keystroke; the light / laptop members ring (comb ring in the audit)

key.space.note: a mechanical keyboard space bar, a CC0 recording fitted as code (0.39 s): matches 'a spacebar press' at z +3.22 (typing_key/deep: +2.14), realness 0.99 (0.84); its own top tags include 'a spacebar press'

key.return.note: the deep cap pressed firmer (its own seed): return sits 2.5 dB over the space bar

click.note: a small plastic click, a CC0 recording fitted as code (0.13 s, 4.9 kHz centroid): matches 'a soft UI button click' at z +1.70, p 0.73 over synth-blip descriptions (tap/finger, which reads as 'a punchy impact hit': +1.37, 0.61), realness 0.97 (0.89)

click.confirm.note: a soft tuned pluck confirms: the same voice as bell and text, quieter

snap.note: a switch flip, a CC0 recording fitted as code (0.19 s, one attack): matches 'a toggle switch click' at z +2.24, p 1.00 over synth-blip descriptions (pro_pop_in/knock: +0.61, 0.27), realness 0.97 (0.08)

bell.note: the launch film's kalimba on two octaves of the key's pentatonic (10 notes, G4-E6 in G major, set by kit.py tune): one tuned note per progress step or motif note, so a climbing motif has a rung for every step

text.note: one soft tuned note when a text fragment resolves (not per word), on the five pentatonic degrees of one octave (set by kit.py tune); a chain steps through each chord's tones among them, under the picture

off.suck: off by default: a reverse whoosh into a cut stacks a build onto the reveal
off.riser: off by default: a reveal resolves on one element; add pro_riser/air_gate only if the treatment needs a build
off.drop: a calm film resolves without a sub drop; pro_sub_drop/soft tuned to the root is the restrained choice if weight is needed
off.swell: off by default: a reverse swell before a hit is a stacked lead-in
